observations: body L1-L14: the quotation of Thābit ibn Qurrah begun on p. 301. The dots after «signorum» (L3) are five; the sign of equality of L5 measures 9.6 pt. «Albategnj», divided between L8 and L9, is letter-spaced, with the hyphen of the line end. Addenda, p. LXXIX («301–302»): in L1 the codices read «quoniam» for «quatenus», in L2-L3 moverentur for «moventur»; the words left out at the dots of L3 are «et excepit secundum [om. A, V] Abrachis in 300 fere annis fere diem unum in tempore anni»; in L6 A and B rightly read «aequatori»; in L7-L8 the true reading is «necessario igitur facta est»; in L9 A, B and F better read «non procedere secundum», and the true reading is then «proportionem»; in L10 «si ergo fuerit», and at the end of the line A, B and F rightly «tunc» for «et»; in L13 A, B and F read «operatio», and confirm the reading «perfecisset».

body L15-L26: «Abrāhām bar Ḥiyyā», «Al-batenii», divided between L15 and L16, and «Ptolemaeus» (L26) are letter-spaced; «Hebraei–Hispani» has a long dash (5.5 pt), and the dash before «Ptolemaeus» measures 10.1 pt. The dots after «perfectos.» (L25) are five; a speck stands over the full stop. Bar Ḥiyyā's 800 years are the half of the 1600 years of the revolution of the pole of the ecliptic.

body L27-L40: «al–Battānī» (L28, L33) is letter-spaced, «al–Battānī» (L38) is not; the long dashes of «al–Ma’mūn» and «al–Battānī» measure 5.3 to 5.5 pt, and the dashes before «Sapientes» (L27) and «Magnum» (L40) 10.2 and 8.8 pt. «ante Ptolemaeo» (L29) is printed so. 420 + 720 = 1140 years and 4° 1/5 + 11° = 15° 1/5, as printed; 4° 1/5 in 420 years is 1° in 100 years, and 11° in 720 years 1° 32′ in 100 years, about the 1° 1/2 of L34.
notes_left L1-L5: the closing parenthesis of «(1)» prints broken, like a comma, and the r of «Abracis» prints broken.
notes_right L3-L5: «196–200» has a long dash (4.3 pt); the dash before «De» measures 8.8 pt. Abraham bar Ḥiyyā's book is described on p. 287.

review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
